exposure: histophenotype of the extracellular matrix of the cervical stroma (normal, intermediate, myxoid)
cohort: The study cohort included 160 women of reproductive age with cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN 1-3), including those with confirmed persistence or lesion progression, and a control group of 40 women with morphologically intact cervical tissue.
finding: The myxoid histophenotype of the extracellular matrix was significantly associated with a high degree of dysplasia (CIN 3) and the persistence of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia.
